# ANOVA v0.7.2 - Table of Contents

ANOVA implementation in Elixir.

## Pages

- [ANOVA](https://anova.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://anova.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [ANOVA](https://anova.hexdocs.pm/ANOVA.md): ANOVA (Analysis of variance)

- [MathUtils](https://anova.hexdocs.pm/MathUtils.md): Utility functions used in ANOVA and post-hoc test calculations.

- [StudentizedRange](https://anova.hexdocs.pm/StudentizedRange.md): Studentized range distribution for Tukey's HSD.
- [TukeyHSD](https://anova.hexdocs.pm/TukeyHSD.md): Tukey's Honestly Significant Difference (HSD) post-hoc test.
